from collections import Counter
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = set(v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2))
    marker = next(v for v, n in counts.most_common() if v not in background)
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts}
    h = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    w = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    for r in range(len(grid)-h+1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])-w+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
